stem: Anvi's calculator starts at $0$ and has only a $+1000$ button. She wants the display to show exactly $4000$.

options.text: Mix $+100$ and $+1000$ taps, even though only the $+1000$ button is available.
Call the answer "presses" and stop before finding how many $+1000$ taps make $4000$.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

part_answers.answer: Only the $+1000$ button is available, so $4000$ needs exactly four presses of that button.

teacher.key_rationale: With only +1000, 4000 needs 4 presses. Mixing other buttons violates the single-button condition. Stopping at the word presses omits the count.
